build_VisionTransformer: build a VisionTransformer model with custom image size, patch size, and number of layers for image classification
create_ViTb16_model: create a ViTB16 Vision Transformer model with 12 layers and 768 hidden dimensions for image classification
create_ViTl16_model: create a ViTL16 Vision Transformer model with 24 layers and 1024 hidden dimensions for image classification
create_ViTl14_model: create a ViTH14 Vision Transformer model with 32 layers and 1280 hidden dimensions for image classification
create_VisionTransformerHead: create a VisionTransformerHead classification head with optional hidden layer and L2 normalization for the model
